citation: Jiu's Sharing Station, "China Train Rules & Fees Cheat Sheet", checked 2026-11-05, https://jiunotes.top/china-train-rules-fees-cheatsheet
note: Every entry carries the official Chinese source that states it and the date it was last checked. Rules change without announcement; compare checked_on against your travel date.

facts.claim_en: China train tickets go on sale 15 days in advance (including the day of sale)
facts.claim_zh: 中国火车票预售期为15天（含当天）

source.name: 新华网（转中国铁路官方）

facts.claim_en: Guangzhou-Shenzhen-Hong Kong cross-border high-speed rail tickets: 15-day advance sale (incl. sale day)
facts.claim_zh: 广深港跨境高铁车票预售期为15天（含当天）

facts.claim_en: Official purchase channels: 12306 website/App is the ONLY official channel; also station windows, ticket machines, phone booking and authorized agents
facts.claim_zh: 购票渠道：12306网站（含铁路12306移动端）是唯一官方网站；另有车站窗口、自动售票机、订票电话和代售点

facts.claim_en: Each ticket can be changed ONCE (including changing the destination station) when capacity allows
facts.claim_zh: 每张车票在有运输能力的前提下可办理1次改签（含变更到站）

facts.claim_en: Changing a ticket carries no percentage fee. You simply pay the fare difference if the new ticket costs more, or get the difference back if it costs less. The only fee that can arise is the refund fee, and only if you later cancel instead of travelling.
facts.claim_zh: 改签不收百分比手续费：新车票更贵的补差额，更便宜的退还差额。唯一可能产生的费用是退票费，而且只有在你后来选择退票、而不是乘车时才会收。

source.name: 中国铁路12306官网（铁路旅客购票须知）

facts.claim_en: Children under 6 ride free (one per adult, no seat); ages 6-13 get child discount fare; ages 14+ pay full fare
facts.claim_zh: 未满6周岁免费乘车（每名成人限1名不占席）；6-13周岁购儿童优惠票；年满14周岁购全价票

facts.claim_en: Child discount fare: 50% of full fare on conventional trains and EMU 2nd/1st class; 70% on EMU sleeper
facts.claim_zh: 儿童优惠票：普速列车及动车二等/一等座按全价50%计；动车卧铺按全价70%计
facts.figure: 50% of full fare (70% for EMU sleeper)

facts.claim_en: Cross-border ticket ID types: Chinese resident ID, Mainland Travel Permit / residence permits for HK/Macao/Taiwan residents, foreign permanent residence ID, valid passports, temporary ID
facts.claim_zh: 跨境购票可用证件：居民身份证、港澳台居民居住证、港澳居民来往内地通行证、台湾居民来往大陆通行证、外国人永久居留身份证、有效护照及临时身份证明

facts.claim_en: The 12306 English website accepts ONLY valid foreign passports for ticket purchase
facts.claim_zh: 12306英文网站仅接受有效外国护照购票

facts.claim_en: Free checked/hand luggage weight: 20 kg per adult, 10 kg per child, 35 kg for diplomatic personnel
facts.claim_zh: 免费携带品重量：其他旅客20千克、儿童10千克、外交人员35千克

facts.claim_en: Carry-on size: sum of length+width+height up to 160 cm on conventional trains, 130 cm on EMU; rod-shaped items up to 200 cm; each piece up to 20 kg
facts.claim_zh: 携带品尺寸：长宽高之和不超过160厘米（动车组130厘米），杆状物品不超过200厘米，每件重量不超过20千克

facts.claim_en: Restricted carry-on: cigarettes up to 50 cartons; liquor with 24%-70% alcohol up to 3000 ml; live animals prohibited (guide dogs and sealed aquatic food excepted)
facts.claim_zh: 限量携带品：香烟最多50条；酒精含量24%-70%的白酒不超过3000毫升；活动物禁带（导盲犬和封闭包装水产除外）

facts.claim_en: Beijing-Shanghai HSR published (list) fares rose 20% from 26 May 2026 for 300-350 km/h and 200-250 km/h EMU trains; execution fares capped by published fare with variable discounts
facts.claim_zh: 京沪高铁公布票价自2026年5月26日起上浮20%（时速300~350公里及200~250公里及以下动车组）；执行票价以公布票价为上限、按不同幅度折扣浮动

source.name: 京沪高速铁路股份有限公司（上交所公告）

facts.claim_en: Beijing-Shanghai HSR full-route 2nd class published-fare cap about 820 CNY (from 26 May 2026); actual execution fares roughly 576-672 CNY depending on train and time
facts.claim_zh: 京沪高铁全程二等座公布票价上限约820元（2026年5月26日起）；实际执行票价约576~672元（因车次、时段不同浮动）

source.name: 中国新闻周刊（京沪高铁公司公告核实）

facts.claim_en: Refund fee: FREE when cancelling 8+ days before departure
facts.claim_zh: 退票费：开车前8天以上退票不收取退票费

facts.claim_en: Refund fee: 5% when cancelling 48 hours to 8 days before departure
facts.claim_zh: 退票费：开车前48小时至8天退票按票面价格5%计

facts.claim_en: Refund fee: 10% when cancelling 24-48 hours before departure
facts.claim_zh: 退票费：开车前24小时至48小时退票按票面价格10%计

facts.claim_en: Refund fee: 20% when cancelling less than 24 hours before departure
facts.claim_zh: 退票费：开车前不足24小时退票按票面价格20%计

facts.claim_en: Refund fee rounded to nearest 0.5 yuan, minimum 2 yuan (less than 2 yuan charged at ticket price)
facts.claim_zh: 退票费以5角为单位计算，最低按2元计收（票价不足2元时按票价计收）

facts.claim_en: Refund timing: cancel before departure online; tickets changed after departure and points-exchange tickets are NOT refundable; cash purchases refunded at station window within 180 days after online cancellation
facts.claim_zh: 退票时限：开车前可网上退票；开车后改签的车票和积分兑换车票不办理退票；现金购票线上退票后180日内到车站窗口退款

facts.claim_en: Students get 4 discounted one-way trips per academic year (Oct 1 - Sep 30); 50% conventional hard seat, 75% EMU 2nd class
facts.claim_zh: 学生优惠票：每学年（10月1日至次年9月30日）可购4次单程；普速硬座50%、动车二等座75%

facts.claim_en: Waitlist (候补) purchase: each user can submit 2 waitlist orders, each with 2 adjacent dates and up to 5 train/class combos, up to 9 passengers per order; deadline no later than 2 hours before departure
facts.claim_zh: 候补购票：每位用户可提交2个候补订单，每个订单含2个相邻日期、5个车次席别组合，最多9名乘车人；截止时间不晚于开车前2小时

facts.claim_en: The National Railway Administration put China's high-speed operating mileage at 48,000 km at the end of 2024, more than 70% of the world total.
Perfume, toilet water, sprays and gels - flammable non-aerosol daily-use containers - are limited to containers of no more than 100 ml each, one container per type.
facts.claim_zh: 香水、花露水、喷雾、凝胶等含易燃成分的非自喷压力容器日用品，单体容器容积不超过100毫升，每种限带1件。

facts.claim_en: Nail polish and nail-polish remover are limited to a cumulative 50 ml.
facts.claim_zh: 指甲油、去光剂累计不超过50毫升。

facts.claim_en: Aerosol cans - cold-wave liquid, hair dye, mousse, hairspray, insecticide, air freshener - are limited to 150 ml per can, one per type, cumulative no more than 600 ml.
facts.claim_zh: 冷烫精、染发剂、摩丝、发胶、杀虫剂、空气清新剂等自喷压力容器，单体容器容积不超过150毫升，每种限带1件，累计不超过600毫升。

facts.claim_en: Safety matches are limited to 2 small boxes and ordinary lighters to 2 units.
facts.claim_zh: 安全火柴不超过2小盒，普通打火机不超过2个。

facts.claim_en: Clearly labelled power banks and lithium batteries are limited to a single rated energy of no more than 100 Wh; electric wheelchairs containing lithium batteries are excepted.
facts.claim_zh: 标志清晰的充电宝、锂电池，单块额定能量不超过100Wh，含有锂电池的电动轮椅除外。

facts.claim_en: Daily-use cutting tools with a blade longer than 60 mm - kitchen knives, fruit knives, scissors, craft knives - may not be carried on board but may be checked as baggage.
facts.claim_zh: 锐器：菜刀、水果刀、剪刀、美工刀、雕刻刀、裁纸刀等日用刀具（刀刃长度超过60毫米），禁止随身携带但可以托运。

facts.claim_en: The railway prohibited-and-restricted items catalogue for passengers took effect on 1 July 2022, replacing the 2015 list.
facts.claim_zh: 本公告自2022年7月1日起施行，原《国家铁路局 公安部关于发布铁路〈禁止携带物品目录〉的公告》（国铁运输监〔2015〕3号）同时废止。

facts.claim_en: China Railway 12306 permits one change per ticket with no percentage fee: more than 48 hours before departure you may switch to any train in the 15-day sale window, while inside 48 hours only a train on the same travel date or earlier, under the 2023 official change rules ( source ).
At the end of 2025 China had 165,000 km of railway in operation, of which 50,000 km was high-speed rail — the largest high-speed network in the world.
facts.claim_zh: 截至 2025 年底，全国铁路营业里程 16.5 万公里，其中高速铁路 5.0 万公里，为世界最大的高速铁路网。

source.name: National Railway Administration (国家铁路局《2025年铁道统计公报》)

facts.claim_en: China's railways carried 4.601 billion passengers in 2025, up 6.7% year on year — a record high — and moved 5.277 billion tonnes of freight, up 2.0%.
facts.claim_zh: 2025 年全国铁路旅客发送量 46.01 亿人次，同比增长 6.7%，创历史新高；货运总发送量 52.77 亿吨，同比增长 2.0%。

source.name: National Railway Administration (国家铁路局《2025年铁道统计公报》)

facts.claim_en: In 2025 China put 3,109 km of new railway lines into service, including 2,862 km of high-speed rail, with fixed-asset investment of CNY 901.5 billion.
facts.claim_zh: 2025 年全国铁路投产新线 3109 公里，其中高速铁路 2862 公里；铁路固定资产投资完成 9015 亿元。

source.name: National Railway Administration (国家铁路局《2025年铁道统计公报》)

facts.claim_en: By the end of 2024, 54 Chinese cities had urban rail transit in operation — 325 lines, 10,945.6 km of track and 6,324 stations; 43 of those cities run metro or light-rail lines.
facts.claim_zh: 截至 2024 年底，全国 54 个城市开通运营城市轨道交通，共 325 条线路、运营里程 10945.6 公里、车站 6324 座；其中 43 个城市开通地铁或轻轨。

facts.claim_en: Urban rail transit in China recorded 32.24 billion passenger trips in 2024, up 9.5% year on year, with 408.5 million train runs.
facts.claim_zh: 2024 年全国城市轨道交通完成客运量 322.4 亿人次，同比增长 9.5%，实际开行列车 4085 万列次。

facts.claim_en: At the end of 2024 China had 263 certified civil aviation transport airports, with scheduled domestic flights serving 258 cities.
facts.claim_zh: 截至 2024 年底，全国颁证民用航空运输机场 263 个，定期航班国内通航城市 258 个。

facts.claim_en: China had 190,700 km of expressways at the end of 2024, within a total road network of 5.49 million km.
facts.claim_zh: 截至 2024 年底，全国高速公路里程 19.07 万公里，公路总里程 549.04 万公里。

facts.claim_en: China is the only country in the world running high-speed trains at a commercial speed of 350 km/h; 350 km/h Fuxing trains serve the Beijing-Shanghai, Beijing-Tianjin, Beijing-Zhangjiakou, Chengdu-Chongqing and Beijing-Guangzhou lines.
facts.claim_zh: 中国是世界上唯一实现高铁时速 350 公里商业运营的国家，京沪、京津、京张、成渝、京广等线路的复兴号按 350 公里高标运营。

facts.claim_en: China's high-speed rail network reaches 96% of Chinese cities with a population above 500,000, and Hong Kong is connected to the national high-speed network.
facts.claim_zh: 中国高铁覆盖全国 96% 的 50 万人口以上城市，香港已接入全国高铁网。

facts.claim_en: Fastest scheduled journey times: Beijing to Shanghai 4 h 18 min (about 12 h before high-speed rail) and Beijing to Guangzhou 7 h 16 min (about 21 h before).
facts.claim_zh: 最快运行时间：北京到上海 4 小时 18 分（高铁开通前约 12 小时），北京到广州 7 小时 16 分（此前约 21 小时）。

facts.claim_en: Chinese airlines carried 730.2 million passengers in 2024, up 17.9% year on year; international routes carried 65.56 million, up 125.6%.
facts.claim_zh: 2024 年中国民航完成旅客运输量 7.302 亿人次，同比增长 17.9%；其中国际航线 6,555.55 万人次，同比增长 125.6%。

source.name: 2024 Statistical Bulletin on the Development of the Transport Industry, Ministry of Transport

facts.claim_en: China's 263 civil transport airports handled 1.46 billion passenger trips in 2024, up 15.9%; 40 airports passed 10 million passengers a year. The country had 66 airlines, 4,394 transport aircraft and 5,334 scheduled routes.
facts.claim_zh: 2024 年全国 263 个民航运输机场完成旅客吞吐量 14.60 亿人次，同比增长 15.9%；年旅客吞吐量 1,000 万人次以上的机场 40 个。全行业运输航空公司 66 家、运输飞机 4,394 架、定期航班航线 5,334 条。

source.name: 2024 Statistical Bulletin on the Development of the Transport Industry, Ministry of Transport

facts.claim_en: Urban passenger transport in China totalled 106.8 billion trips in 2024 (up 5.7%), split between buses and trolleybuses (38.67 billion), taxis (35.84 billion) and urban rail (32.21 billion, up 9.6%).
facts.claim_zh: 2024 年全国城市客运量 1,067.97 亿人次，同比增长 5.7%；其中公共汽电车 386.70 亿、出租汽车 358.41 亿、城市轨道交通 322.09 亿人次（同比增长 9.6%）。

source.name: 2024 Statistical Bulletin on the Development of the Transport Industry, Ministry of Transport

facts.claim_en: At the end of 2025 China's national rail fleet comprised 22,700 locomotives (14,700 electric), 83,000 passenger coaches including 5,230 EMU sets (41,836 cars), and 1.024 million freight wagons.
facts.claim_zh: 截至 2025 年底，全国铁路机车拥有量 2.27 万台（电力机车 1.47 万台），客车 8.3 万辆（其中动车组 5230 标准组、41836 辆），货车 102.4 万辆。

source.name: National Railway Administration (国家铁路局《2025年铁道统计公报》)

facts.claim_en: China's rail network density reached 171.7 km per 10,000 km² at the end of 2025, with a double-track rate of 61.4%, electrification rate of 76.8%, and 67,000 km of railway in the western region.
facts.claim_zh: 截至 2025 年底，全国铁路路网密度 171.7 公里/万平方公里，复线率 61.4%，电化率 76.8%，西部地区铁路营业里程 6.7 万公里。

source.name: National Railway Administration (国家铁路局《2025年铁道统计公报》)

facts.claim_en: Which document you can use to buy a Chinese train ticket depends on the channel. At a station ticket window, a ticket agent's counter or on board (for tickets and fare top-ups), seven document types are accepted: Foreign Permanent Resident ID, foreign passport, foreigner exit-entry permit, seaman's book, the receipt issued by the public security exit-entry administration for a pending visa application, a police report of a lost passport, and a temporary international travel document issued by an embassy or consulate carrying a valid Chinese visa or stay permit. On the 12306 English website, the 12306 app and the booking hotline, only the Foreign Permanent Resident ID and the foreign passport work. Ticket machines accept only the Foreign Permanent Resident ID — a foreign passport will not work there.
facts.claim_zh: 外国旅客购买中国火车票，可用证件按渠道分三档：①车站售票窗口 / 代售点 / 车上补票 = 7 类（外国人永久居留身份证、护照、外国人出入境证、海员证、签证证件受理回执、护照报失证明、使领馆签发的附有效签证的临时国际旅行证件）；②12306 英文版网站 / APP / 订票电话 = 仅永居证 + 护照；③自动售票机 = 仅永居证（护照不可用）。

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: Foreign travellers must complete identity verification before buying a train ticket — Chinese rail sells tickets against real names. There are two routes: log in to the 12306 English website or app and enter your name, nationality and document number for automatic verification (or upload a photo of the passport data page for manual review), or take the physical passport to a station ticket window and have it verified there.
facts.claim_zh: 外国旅客购票前必须完成身份核验（铁路实名制）。两条路径：①登录 12306 英文版网站或 APP，填写姓名、国籍、证件号码由系统自动核验，也可上传护照信息页照片由后台人工核验；②携带本人有效护照到车站售票窗口办理核验。

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: On the 12306 English website and app you can pay with domestic or overseas bank cards and with mobile payment apps. At a station window you can additionally pay cash in RMB. Some stations also have self-service ticket machines. Cards are processed in RMB, so your issuer applies its own conversion.
facts.claim_zh: 在 12306 英文版网站和 APP 上购票，可用境内外银行卡及移动支付 APP 付款；车站窗口另可用人民币现金。部分车站设有自助售票机。票价按人民币计收，货币转换由发卡行完成。
facts.figure: domestic + overseas cards accepted payment methods

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: Change windows: more than 48 hours before departure you can move your ticket to any train inside the 15-day sale window. Within 48 hours you can only change to the same travel date or earlier — not the next day or any later date. After the train has left you can still change to another train that same day, but a ticket changed after departure can never be refunded.
facts.claim_zh: 改签时间窗：开车前 48 小时以上，可改签到 15 天预售期内的任意列车；开车前 48 小时以内，只能改签到票面乘车日期当日及以前，不能改次日及以后；开车之后仍可改签当日其他列车，但开车后改签的车票不能再退票。

source.name: China Railway 12306 – Ticket Purchase Notice (铁路旅客购票须知)

facts.claim_en: Changing the destination station must be done more than 48 hours before departure. Inside that window a destination change is not accepted at all.
facts.claim_zh: 变更到站必须赶在开车前 48 小时以上办理；进入 48 小时以内就不再受理变更到站。

source.name: China Railway 12306 – Ticket Purchase Notice (铁路旅客购票须知)

facts.claim_en: Anti-loophole rule: if you bought a ticket less than 8 days before departure, then changed it to a train departing 8 or more days later, and then refunded it 8+ days out, a 5% refund fee is still charged — the free-cancel window does not open up just by rescheduling.
facts.claim_zh: 防钻空子条款：距开车不足 8 天买的车票，先改签到开车前 8 天以上的列车，再在开车前 8 天以上退票，仍要按票面价 5% 收退票费——不能靠改签「刷新」出免费退票窗口。

source.name: China Railway 12306 – Refund FAQ (退票费怎么收)

facts.claim_en: Spring Festival rule: if a changed ticket travels during the Spring Festival rush, refunding it is charged at the under-24-hours rate of 20% — even if you cancel weeks in advance. Buying a discounted ticket for the rush and cancelling later is therefore expensive.
facts.claim_zh: 春运条款：改签后车票的乘车日期落在春运期间的，退票一律按「开车前不足 24 小时」标准收 20% 退票费——哪怕提前几周退也一样。春运票退改成本明显更高。

source.name: China Railway 12306 – Ticket Purchase Notice (铁路旅客购票须知)

facts.claim_en: Once you cancel a ticket or request a refund, the railway must complete the refund within 7 working days. That clock excludes bank/card processing time and any delay caused by the passenger.
facts.claim_zh: 办理退票、申请退款后，铁路须在 7 个工作日内办结退款手续；该时限不含银行等金融机构的处理时间和旅客自身原因造成的延误。

source.name: Ministry of Transport – Railway Passenger Transport Regulations (Order No. 37 of 2022)

facts.claim_en: Mistaken-purchase free cancellation (since 19 January 2026): if you bought the wrong ticket, you can cancel online at no charge when you cancel within 30 minutes of successful payment AND more than 4 hours before departure. Limit one such order per person per calendar day; rescheduled tickets, reservations and waitlisted orders do not qualify.
facts.claim_zh: 误购限时免费退票（2026-01-19 起）：买错票时，只要在支付成功 30 分钟内、且距开车 4 小时以上，可在 12306 线上自助免费退票。同一购票人每个自然日限办 1 个订单；改签车票、预约与候补订单不适用。

source.name: China State Railway Group – 2026 Spring Festival ticket sales announcement

facts.claim_en: Reimbursement receipts must be collected within 180 days — before departure, or within 180 days from the travel date — at a station window or ticket machine, using the same ID used for purchase. Once printed, a lost receipt is never reissued, and you must hand it back if you later change or refund the ticket.
facts.claim_zh: 报销凭证须在 180 天内换取：开车前，或自乘车日期起 180 天以内，凭购票所用有效身份证件到车站窗口或自动售票机换取。已打印的凭证丢失不再补办；之后办理改签、退票时须交回。

source.name: China Railway 12306 – Ticket Purchase Notice (铁路旅客购票须知)

facts.claim_en: A child's age is counted as of the travel date, not the booking date. Anyone under 14 must travel with an adult; a free-riding child (under 6, not occupying a seat, one per ticketed adult) must still present valid ID at the gate.
facts.claim_zh: 儿童年龄按乘车日期计算，不按购票日期。未满 14 周岁须随同成年人旅行；免费乘车儿童（未满 6 周岁、不单独占座、每名持票成人限带 1 名）检票乘车时同样要出示有效身份证件。

source.name: China Railway 12306 – Ticket Purchase Notice (铁路旅客购票须知)

facts.claim_en: Student discount tickets need an eligibility check once per academic year (1 October – 30 September): verify your ID against the student discount card at 12306 online, a station window or a ticket machine before you travel. Without the check the discount will not be honoured.
facts.claim_zh: 学生优惠票每学年（10 月 1 日至次年 9 月 30 日）须办理一次优惠资质核验：出发前通过 12306 网站、车站指定窗口或自动售票机，把身份证件与学生优惠卡绑定核验。未核验不予享受优惠。

source.name: China Railway 12306 – Ticket Purchase Notice (铁路旅客购票须知)

facts.claim_en: Four behaviours mean you pay the fare for the un-ticketed section PLUS a 50% surcharge: riding without a ticket and not volunteering to pay; staying on past your ticketed stop; sitting in a higher class than the one ticketed; and travelling on a discount or concession ticket you do not qualify for.
facts.claim_zh: 四种行为除补收票款外，还可加收已乘区间应补票款 50%：无票乘车又不主动补票；到站不下车继续乘坐；持低等级席位票坐高等级席位；持不符合减价条件的优惠、优待票乘车。

source.name: Ministry of Transport – Railway Passenger Transport Regulations (Order No. 37 of 2022)

facts.claim_en: Complaint handling deadlines: the railway must acknowledge a complaint within 3 working days and give a substantive answer within 10 working days. If it refuses to handle the complaint it must state why. Complaint records are kept for at least 3 years.
facts.claim_zh: 投诉处理时限：铁路须在收到投诉后 3 个工作日内答复受理情况、10 个工作日内告知实质性处理结果；不予受理须说明理由。投诉记录至少保存 3 年。

source.name: Ministry of Transport – Railway Passenger Transport Regulations (Order No. 37 of 2022)

facts.claim_en: Checked luggage is stored free for at least 3 days from the day it arrives. If the luggage itself arrived late, free storage extends to at least 10 days. Loss or force majeure can extend it further.
facts.claim_zh: 托运行李自运到日起至少免费保管 3 日；属逾期到达的行李至少免费保管 10 日；因行李损失或不可抗力等原因应适当延长。

source.name: Ministry of Transport – Railway Passenger Transport Regulations (Order No. 37 of 2022)

facts.claim_en: Tickets for the first day of the 2026 Spring Festival rush (2 February) went on sale on 19 January 2026 — 15 days ahead, matching the standard advance-sale window.
facts.claim_zh: 2026 年春运首日（2 月 2 日）车票于 2026 年 1 月 19 日开售，提前 15 天，与常规预售期一致。

source.name: China State Railway Group – 2026 Spring Festival ticket sales announcement

facts.claim_en: Non-Chinese permanent residents of Hong Kong or Macao can apply for a Mainland Travel Permit (valid 5 years, multiple entries, stay up to 90 days each) through China Travel Service HK or Macau, or renew it at city-level entry-exit administrations on the mainland.
facts.claim_zh: 非中国籍港澳永久性居民可向香港中旅集团、澳门中国旅行社递交通行证申请；证件有效期5年，可多次来往内地，每次停留不超过90日；换发补发也可向内地设区的市级以上公安机关出入境管理机构申请。
facts.unit: permit validity / max stay per entry
facts.figure: 5 years / 90 days permit validity / max stay per entry

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: Refund fees range from 0% to 20% depending on how far in advance you cancel, according to China Railway 12306.
